title: Neuro-symbolic PRM: Enhancing Scientific Reasoning via Structured Traces and Symbolic Verification
abstract: arXiv:2608.26329v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While tool-augmented Large Language Models have significantly improved multi-step reasoning in quantitative STEM tasks, a critical residual failure mode remains: intermediate reasoning steps that are syntactically well-formed, mathematically executable, and unit-consistent, yet contextually ungrounded. Current approaches either rely on formal verifiers that cannot assess semantic intent, or burden Process Reward Models (PRMs) with the dual task of checking both arithmetic and logic. In this paper, we propose a neuro-symbolic framework that cleanly decouples reasoning into two formal dimensions: Symbolic Validity ($V$) and Semantic Groundedness ($G$). We guarantee $V$ by construction using a deterministic symbolic verifier acting as a hard filter. To assess $G$, we train a PRM conditionally on the verifier-accepted manifold. translated_title: 神经符号PRM：通过结构化轨迹和符号验证增强科学推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26329v1 公告类型：新 摘要：虽然工具增强的大型语言模型在定量STEM任务中的多步推理方面取得了显著改进，但一个关键的残余失败模式仍然存在：中间推理步骤在语法上结构良好、数学上可执行且单位一致，但在上下文上缺乏依据。当前方法要么依赖无法评估语义意图的形式验证器，要么将检查算术和逻辑的双重任务负担给过程奖励模型（PRMs）。在本文中，我们提出了一种神经符号框架，将推理清晰地解耦为两个形式维度：符号有效性（$V$）和语义依据性（$G$）。我们通过使用确定性符号验证器作为硬过滤器，从结构上保证$V$。为了评估$G$，我们在验证器接受的流形上条件化训练一个PRM。为了高效训练该PRM，我们引入了反事实符号扰动（CSP），一种新颖的数据合成方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种神经符号框架，通过将推理解耦为符号有效性和语义依据性两个维度，并采用确定性验证器和条件化过程奖励模型，有效解决了大型语言模型在科学推理中中间步骤缺乏上下文依据的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a neuro-symbolic framework that decouples reasoning into symbolic validity and semantic groundedness dimensions, using a deterministic verifier and a conditionally trained PRM to address the issue of contextually ungrounded intermediate steps in scientific reasoning.
